requirements.verbatim_text: Bids Due: July 24,2026 by 10:00 a.m. Central Time
Bidder is required to sign and return an Addendum or Addenda with the Bid.
Deadline for Submission of Bids (NOTE: Bids must be RECEIVED by TWC by the deadline) July 24,2026 at 10:00 AM Central Time
Bidder must submit its Bid to TWC in accordance with the due date and time as indicated in this Schedule of Events or as changed via a notification of an Addendum posted to the ESBD.
Only bids on items conforming exactly to these specifications, which include proposing only the brand name(s), make and model number(s) specified, will be considered in determining an award.
Successful Bidder must provide the acSoft Inc ServiceNow Power BI plug-in connector.

Successful Bidder must provide key features of the acSoft Inc ServiceNow Power BI plug-in connector which include: 1. The ability to export any ServiceNow tables and fields (including Custom tables and fields); 2. The ability to include any amount of tables and fields to your Data Source; 3. The ability to create any amount of Data Sources (data sets); 4. No limitations in exported data.
The Contract Term will commence on the later of August 15, 2026 or the fully executed Contract date and expire twelve (12) months from that date.
Bids shall be binding for a period of ninety (90) days after the submission due date.

If Bidder asserts that information provided in its Bid is exempt from disclosure under the Texas Public Information Act, Bidder must mark and submit two separate, searchable Portable Document Format (PDF) copies (Original Bid and "Public Information Act Copy," including attachments, of the Original Bid) as identified below. This copy is in addition to the original and all copies otherwise required under the provisions of this Solicitation.

Within five (5) Business days from Contract execution, the Successful Bidder must submit a "Public Information Act Copy" of the Original Executed Contract (in addition to the original executed contract) to the TWC contract manager by email.

The Public Information Act Copy must meet the following requirements: a. The copy must be clearly marked as "Public Information Act Copy" on the front page in large, bold, capitalized letters (the size of, or equivalent to, 12-point Arial font or larger); b. Each portion Successful Bidder claims is exempt from public disclosure must be redacted (blacked out); and c. Successful Bidder must identify, adjacent to each redaction, the claimed exemption from disclosure.
There must be no redactions in the Original Contract.

For the duration of any Contract resulting from this Solicitation, the Successful Bidder shall acquire insurance, bonds, or both, with financially sound and reputable independent insurers, in the type and amount listed in Attachment 1 – TWC Terms and Conditions.

During the term of the Contract or any extension or renewal thereof, the Successful Bidder shall notify TWC in writing of any substantial change in the ownership or control of the Successful Bidder as soon as possible, but no later than thirty (30) days prior to its occurrence.
Successful Bidder must also notify TWC in writing of any change in financial condition as soon as possible, but no later than ten (10) days after its occurrence.
The Successful Bidder must make payment within thirty (30) days of TWC's demand.

Upon receipt of written notice, the Successful Bidder will have ten (10) days to provide a written explanation of any justification that may be applicable to the liquidated damages being considered and a corrective action plan for bringing the operations within the standards specified.

In all cases, the corrective action plan must be approved by TWC in writing prior to implementation. The corrective action plan must be implemented by the Successful Bidder at no cost to and upon approval by the TWC Contract Manager.
The Successful Bidder must make payment within thirty (30) days of TWC's demand.
Bidder must be set up in the Texas franchise tax system prior to Contract award if applicable.
Bidder must indicate whether or not it holds any financial interest in any Subcontractor.

As a condition of award, an authorized officer or agent of each proposed Subcontractor may be required to sign a statement to the effect that the Subcontractor has read, and will agree to abide by, Bidder's obligations under any Contract awarded pursuant to this Solicitation.

The Successful Bidder must obtain prior written approval from TWC if any part of the Contract between TWC and the Successful Bidder is to be subcontracted, and the Subcontractor must comply with all applicable requirements of TWC.
All requests, questions, or other communication about this Solicitation must be directed to the Sole Point of Contact.
Except as provided in Section 4.1.1 (Sole Point of Contact) a potential Bidder and Bidder that has submitted a Bid is prohibited from any communication with TWC regarding the Solicitation.

Bidder shall rely only on written statements issued by or through TWC designated staff as provided by Section 4.1 (Inquiries). Failure to comply with these restrictions may result in disqualification of Bidder's Bid.
Bidder must fully and completely address all requirements described in this Solicitation. Incomplete or partial Bids will not be considered.
The Bidder must provide all information that the Bidder believes would be helpful to TWC in evaluating the Bidder's ability to fulfill the Solicitation requirements.
Bidders must notify the Sole Point of Contact, Section 4.1, of any ambiguity, conflict, discrepancy, exclusionary specification, omission, or other error in the IFB.
Bids must be received by PS as prescribed no later than date and time specified in Section 1.3 (Schedule of Events).
You must submit your bid electronically by email to VendorProposals@twc.texas.gov. Reference the IFB Title, IFB No., and the Submission Deadline date and time, in the subject line.
Hard copies received will not be accepted or reviewed.
Each Bidder is solely responsible for ensuring its Bid is submitted in accordance with all Solicitation requirements and ensuring timely receipt by TWC.
Bidder has completed, signed and submitted Form 1 – Execution of Bid in accordance with Section 6.1 Execution of Bid.
Bidder has completed and submitted Form 2 – Cost Sheet in accordance with Section 6.3 Cost Sheet.
Bidder who receives an overall score as recorded in the CPA Texas Vendor Performance Tracking System (VPTS) of "D" or below shall be disqualified from consideration for award.
TWC will consider the purchase price and whether the Bidder meets all requirements of this IFB.

Bidder must complete, sign, and return Form 1 – Execution of Bid. By signing, Bidder agrees to provide the goods and/or services described in this Solicitation and agrees to abide by all TWC Terms and Conditions as specified in this Solicitation and in any Contract resulting from an award.
Cost information must be included as a separate document and presented only in the format set forth in Form 2 – Cost Sheet of this Solicitation.
